tools.name: ai_graveyard
tools.description: AI products FalcoScan has verified as shut down or acquired, each with a published source: what happened, the year, the buyer and the market. Filter by year, buyer or market. Up to 25 rows per call, newest first.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every AI market FalcoScan scores, with its public averages (opportunity, saturation, wrapper share, heat), how many products in it are operating, and a link to its market page.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: One AI market: how many products are operating, its public averages, how many of its products shut down or were acquired, and its top 10 operating products in the order its FalcoScan market page lists them, with bands.
